Container.Name: ornge-tracker
Container.Overview: Live map of Ornge (Ontario air ambulance) aircraft from public ADS-B data, with last-known positions for the whole fleet.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the map page (container listens on 8080)

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Saved last positions (state.json) and manual fleet list (fleet.json)

Config.Name: FlightAware API key
Config.Description: Optional AeroAPI key (flightaware.com/aeroapi). Adds filed destination and ETA for flights with a flight plan.

Config.Name: ADS-B API
Config.Description: Any readsb-style v2 API, e.g. https://api.adsb.lol

Config.Name: ADS-B fallback API
Config.Description: Comma-separated APIs tried in order when the main one fails or rate-limits (empty = none)

Config.Name: Poll interval (s)
Config.Description: Seconds between position polls of the fleet

Config.Name: Callsign scan interval (s)
Config.Description: Seconds between PUL callsign scans over Ontario (0 = off)

Config.Name: Trail minutes
Config.Description: How much flight trail to keep and draw

Config.Name: Live seconds
Config.Description: A position older than this is shown as last known

Config.Name: FlightAware daily request limit
Config.Description: Max AeroAPI requests per day, to stay within the free monthly credit

Config.Name: FlightAware refresh (min)
Config.Description: Re-check a live flight's ETA this often (0 = once per flight)

Config.Name: FlightAware skip types
Config.Description: Aircraft types never looked up (helicopters rarely file)

Config.Name: Airport regions
Config.Description: OurAirports regions used for destination lines, e.g. CA-ON,CA-QC,CA-MB (empty = worldwide)
